title: CLADE: Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence in Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.14355v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented systems often retrieve passages that are accurate and relevant but state the answer at a coarser level of granularity than the question requires. For example, a question may ask which specific disease a drug treats (familial hyperlipidemia), while the retrieved passage mentions the broader disease family (hyperlipidemia). Prior work on context sufficiency treats such coarse passages simply as insufficient. We argue that they form a distinct case, which we call resolvable insufficiency: text alone cannot settle the fine-grained answer, but the broader category it mentions maps to a short list of candidate answers in a domain ontology. When language models read these coarse, family-only passages, they exhibit a phenomenon we call Clade (Category-Level Answering from Deficient Evidence): they answer instead of abstaining or searching further. translated_title: CLADE：检索增强语言模型中基于不足证据的类别级回答
translated_abstract: 检索增强系统所检索到的段落往往准确且相关，但其陈述答案的粒度比问题所需的更粗。例如，问题可能询问某药物治疗的特定疾病（家族性高脂血症），而检索到的段落仅提及更宽泛的疾病家族（高脂血症）。先前关于上下文充分性的研究只是简单地将这类粗粒度段落视为不充分。我们认为它们构成了一个独特的情形，我们称之为“可解决的不足”：仅凭文本无法确定细粒度的答案，但其中提到的更宽泛类别可以在领域本体中映射到一个较短的候选答案列表。当语言模型阅读这些仅包含家族层面信息的粗粒度段落时，它们会表现出一种我们称为 Clade（基于不足证据的类别级回答）的现象：模型会直接作答，而不是弃答或进一步检索。在来自 PrimeKG 的生物医学问题上，仅包含家族信息的段落使弃答率降低了（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了语言模型在阅读仅包含粗粒度类别信息（如疾病家族而非具体疾病）的检索段落时会直接作答而非弃答的“Clade”现象，并提出这类“可解决的不足”可通过领域本体中的候选答案列表来刻画与处理。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies "Clade," a phenomenon where language models directly answer instead of abstaining or searching further when retrieved passages only state a coarser category, a case the authors call "resolvable insufficiency" since the broader category maps to a short candidate list in a domain ontology.
